status.en: 209 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, most of them in Delhi, Mumbai and Hyderabad.

summary.en: Security forces killed Lashkar-e-Taiba commander Lateef Ahmad Bhat and other attackers in a Kulgam encounter while recovering a body and weapon, and a man who had sheltered the commander months earlier was also linked to the cell. CRPF special DG reviewed operations at the Srinagar headquarters and intensified searches after the encounter. In Manipur, over 1,000 CRPF personnel were redeployed from Chhattisgarh, including the withdrawal of an anti-Naxal battalion, while Maharashtra announced a cash reward of Rs 1.5 lakh for information on weapons looted by Naxalites. The ISI revived a K‑2 plan to bring multiple terror groups into Punjab to target police. 437 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Sikkerhetsstyrker drepte Lashkar-e-Taiba-kommandanten Lateef Ahmad Bhat og andre angripere i et oppgjør i Kulgam mens de hentet en kropp og et våpen, og en mann som hadde skjult kommandanten måneder tidligere ble også knyttet til cellen. CRPFs spesialdirektør gjennomgikk operasjonene på hovedkvarteret i Srinagar og intensiverte søk etter oppgjøret. I Manipur ble over 1 000 CRPF-personell omplassert fra Chhattisgarh, inkludert tilbaketrekning av et anti-Naxal-bataljon, mens Maharashtra kunngjorde en kontantbelønning på Rs 1.5 lakh for informasjon om våpen plyndret av naxalitter. ISI gjenopptok en K‑2‑plan for å bringe flere terrorgrupper inn i Punjab for å angripe politiet. 437 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Kashmir conflict
background.extract: The Kashmir conflict is a territorial conflict over the Kashmir region, primarily between India and Pakistan, and also between China and India in the northeastern portion of the region. The conflict started after the partition of India in 1947 as both India and Pakistan claimed the entirety of the former princely state of Jammu and Kashmir. It is a dispute over the region that escalated into three wars between India and Pakistan and several other armed skirmishes. India controls approximately 55% of the land area of the region that includes Jammu, the Kashmir Valley, most of Ladakh, the Siachen Glacier, and 70% of its population; Pakistan controls approximately 30% of the land area that includes Azad Kashmir and Gilgit-Baltistan; and China controls the remaining 15% of the land area that includes the Aksai Chin region, the mostly uninhabited Trans-Karakoram Tract, and part of the Demchok sector.
